rationale: Each initial wave needs an explicit, deterministic membership list. Shard digests are established content-addressed identities, and this field preserves the planned grouping without coupling the plan to later physical execution state.
alternatives: derive membership from runs and max_shards_per_wave
store shard indexes instead of digests
simplestChoice: Keep shard_digests as the ordered list of planned shard content digests for the wave.
